Università degli studi di Pavia.notes: Programme is restricted-access with a local SAT-based selection; the 2026/27 window (28 Apr-18 May 2026) is closed and 2027/28 not published yet; the 2027/28 window will probably be similar (April-May 2027), do not assume. Fee: non-EU students with a study visa get the flat rate by default; Morocco is in Bracket 1 of Annex 3 (2026/27 regulation, World Bank classification FY2025; bracket amounts per area are in the regulation Annex 2/3, not read in detail); flat rate range 390-4,550 EUR per year, with 156 EUR fixed enrolment tax. The student can opt out of the flat rate to the equivalent-ISEE calculation with foreign documents (legalised). A 200 EUR place-confirmation fee applies for international students in non-restricted programmes (2.6.2), AI is restricted so check. Quota for non-EU abroad is 45 seats plus 5 Marco Polo (EU-procedure page said 50: conflict). The apply.unipv.eu 'Application Calendar 2026/27' news link returned 404 and is not listed.

Università di Pisa.notes: Programme slug in the TSV is it-pisa-pisa-management-for-business-and-economics-l18. Admission is selective with a test (CEnT, TOLC-E, SAT, GMAT or ACT, min score 10) and a single session for non-EU abroad applicants needing a visa: application until 5 July 2026, ranking 17 July 2026; the 2027/28 call is not published. Places: 50 for this group, of which 5 Marco Polo and 20 Tashkent preparatory year (so about 25 open); the call PDF says 25* in the table, the web page says 50 total. The call PDF gives the EU window to 23 Aug while the web page says 30 Aug (small conflicts). Fees: country-by-income-group flat contribution; Morocco = Lower middle income, coefficient 0.2 (580 EUR on the fees page: 2,900 x 0.2, plus 140 EUR regional tax and 16 EUR stamp). Pisa pages for English-taught courses do not state the Moroccan documents specifically beyond the generic DoV/CIMEA rule; the generic Universitaly page describes Italian-taught Bachelor documents (Italian B2) which do not apply to English-taught courses. Pisa gives no fellowships to international students except DSU/MAECI.
